description:
## Why

The provisioning CLI (stoa-n39yl) covers local server management. A CloudFormation / BYOA deployment also needs a remote admin API so operators can manage users without SSH access to the instance.

## What

A set of authenticated admin-only HTTP endpoints under /admin/:

- POST /admin/users — create user (username, email, password, quota_bytes, is_admin)
- DELETE /admin/users/{username} — delete user and all their data
- GET /admin/users — list all users with usage stats
- PATCH /admin/users/{username} — update display_name, quota_bytes, is_admin
- POST /admin/users/{username}/reset-password — set a new bcrypt hash

Auth: Bearer token (same pattern as existing admin endpoints in stoa — subtle::ConstantTimeEq comparison, never ==). Token configured in Secrets Manager for BYOA deployments.

All admin endpoints return 403 if the request is not from an admin-authed session or does not present the admin bearer token.

DELETE /admin/users/{username}: deletes user row, all metadata rows (mailboxes, messages, flags, state, change log). Does NOT delete blocks from the block store — blocks are shared and GC is a separate concern.

## Acceptance

- All CRUD operations work via HTTP
- Non-admin requests to /admin/* return 403
- User deletion removes all per-user metadata rows
- Block store is not touched by user deletion
- Admin bearer token compared with subtle::ConstantTimeEq
notes: The admin bearer token timing-safe comparison requirement is documented in beads memories (stoa-admin-servers-use-subtle-constanttimeeq-for-bearer). Do not use == for token comparison.
title: Admin HTTP API for user management
